newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing co-op bank savings hit 28.93 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Beijing co-op bank savings hit 28.93 bln yuan.

text.p: Outstanding deposits of the Beijing Urban Cooperative Bank reached 28.93 billion yuan ($3.49 billion) by the end of June, the China Securities newspaper said on Tuesday.
The bank's outstanding loans stood at 10.89 billion yuan at the end of June, with total assets of 34.4 billion yuan, the newspaper said. It did not give comparative figures.
The Beijing Urban Cooperative Bank, with a registered capital of 1.5 billion yuan, was formed early last year by merging Beijing's 90 urban credit cooperatives.
The bank extended a total of 3.14 billion yuan in loans to Beijing's state-owned firms in the first six months of this year, the newspaper said without giving comparative figures.
Most of China's cities have been allowed to set up cooperative banks by merging existing credit cooperatives as part of Beijing's efforts to commercialise the banking system.
